description: Block-tier verdict meta-vectors: (actual, expected) -> grade_block verdict. A comparator implementation is conformant iff it reproduces every `verdict`. Encodes the block-tier grading from grade_block: independent valid + post_digest + cost dimensions; panicked and not-implemented reuse the shared vocabulary. Notable: reject + errored is coal (valid=value) — BY DESIGN mirrors the tx-tier reject arm: the block tier explicitly separates clean-reject (valid:false, error:null) from failed-verdict (error:errored, valid:null). post_digest and cost graded only on the accept arm when valid is nice.

cases.name: accept-all-nice
cases.description: Accept vector: valid:true, post_digest matches, cost matches -> all three dims nice.

cases.name: accept-valid-coal
cases.description: Accept vector: conformer returned valid:false — valid dim is coal, post_digest and cost both n/a.

cases.name: accept-digest-coal
cases.description: Accept vector: valid nice, but post_digest mismatch -> digest coal, cost n/a (digest failed).

cases.name: accept-cost-coal
cases.description: Accept vector: valid nice, post_digest matches, cost mismatch -> cost coal.

cases.name: accept-cost-unclaimed
cases.description: Accept vector: valid nice, post_digest nice, but actual.cost is null -> cost n/a (not graded when either side null).

cases.name: reject-nice
cases.description: Reject vector: expected valid:false, actual valid:false error:null -> valid nice, post_digest n/a, cost n/a.

cases.name: reject-errored-coal
cases.description: BY DESIGN: errored on a reject vector is coal, not a clean rejection. Block tier mirrors tx tier: clean-reject = valid:false error:null; failed-verdict = error:errored valid:null.

cases.name: panicked
cases.description: Panicked actual: coal unconditionally before any expected check.

cases.name: panicked-on-reject-still-coal
cases.description: Panicked on a reject vector: coal unconditionally (a crash is not a clean rejection).
